CustomField.description: How a widget's buttons and notes are laid out. Row of buttons (blank): side by side, as before. Links list: one full-width row per link with an arrow that shows a purple circle on hover. Links list, compact: the same in a narrow column (sidebar) without the circle. Short notes added in the button editor sit between the rows. Not used by the Hero Banner. Blank or unknown means a row of buttons.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Row of buttons puts them side by side. The links lists turn the buttons into rows with an arrow, with any notes between the rows. Choose Links list, compact for a sidebar.
CustomField.label: Button Layout
